Look-alike ages, durations and restrictions from the license-class, permit and graduated-license pages, each tied to one handbook page; hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Permit ages split by permit type: 15 years and 6 months for a graduated or motorcycle permit, but 18 for an operator permit. [A01]
Why it matters: group permits; difficulty two; confusable sec03-F04.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A01
Permit lengths differ by type: a graduated or operator permit lasts 12 months, while a motorcycle permit lasts 7 months with one renewal allowed in 24 months. [A01]
Why it matters: group permits; difficulty three; confusable sec03-F06 versus sec03-F08.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A01
The permit supervisor must be at least 21 and hold a Class A, B, C or D license, while the adult who lifts the graduated night limit must be the teen's parent or legal guardian. [A01]
Why it matters: group supervision; difficulty three; confusable sec03-F05 versus sec03-F11.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
The graduated night limit runs from midnight to 5:00 a.m. and lasts only for the first 6 months of the license. [A01]
Why it matters: group graduated limits; difficulty two; prereq sec03-F11.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A01
Siblings never count against the graduated passenger limit, but a non-sibling passenger under 18 does, and only one is allowed without a licensed parent or guardian up front. [A01]
Why it matters: group graduated limits; difficulty two; prereq sec03-F13.
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0012]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A02
The permit must be held at least 6 months before a graduated license, which is a different 6-month period from the restricted first months of the graduated license itself. [A02]
Why it matters: group graduated licensing; difficulty three; confusable sec03-F16 versus sec03-F24.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A02
Supervised practice is 30 hours with 10 at night in the normal case, but drops to 20 hours with 6 at night only for a minor who completed Traffic Survival School or a Defensive Driving course. [A02]
Why it matters: group graduated licensing; difficulty three; prereq sec03-F18.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A02
For a graduated driver under 18, the first conviction means Traffic Survival School, not a suspension; suspensions start at the second conviction with 3 months and rise to 6 months at the third. [A02]
Why it matters: group penalties; difficulty two; confusable sec03-F22 versus sec03-F23.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A02
The written test is required before an Arizona instruction permit, but the rule does not apply to a Commercial Learner's Permit. [A02]
Why it matters: group permits; difficulty one; prereq sec03-F14.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A03
Married parents need only one parent's signature, while unmarried parents sharing joint custody must both sign. [A03]
Why it matters: group minor applications; difficulty two; prereq sec03-F28.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A03
Selective Service consent is automatic for a male under 26 applying for an original, renewal or reinstatement credential, but optional when he applies only for a duplicate. [A03]
Why it matters: group selective service; difficulty two; prereq sec03-F34.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A04
A Class D operator license needs age 18, while a Class M motorcycle license can be applied for at 16. [A04]
Why it matters: group license classes; difficulty one; confusable sec03-F36 versus sec03-F37.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0015]
